description: This file defines the interface 'ReducibleFunction' for user-defined functions in Apache Spark that can be 'reduced' on other functions, including methods for obtaining reducer functions based on specific criteria.

classes.name: ReducibleFunction
classes.description: An interface for user-defined functions that can be 'reduced' on other functions, providing methods to obtain reducer functions based on input parameters or other functions.

methods.name: reducer
methods.description: Returns a reducer function if the current function is reducible on another bucket function, based on number of buckets and the other function.

methods.name: reducer
methods.description: Returns a reducer function if the current function is reducible on another general function.
